dataDesign.citadelGovernance: Admission and AI-use decisions consume versioned references from the separate Citadel AI-governance plane. That plane stores policy, model, evaluation and approval metadata onlyâ€”not Stratton source documents, production inference state or Internal Audit verdicts.
dataDesign.regionalPattern: Production uses separate private data services in the signed-approved primary/recovery region pair. Global/DataZone AI is prohibited and no implicit Azure geo-pair is accepted unless it is the explicitly approved recovery region.
dataDesign.systemOfRecordBoundary: Existing deal-room, CRM, finance, ESG, legal and compliance systems remain authoritative. Release 1 stores governed evidence copies, metadata, derived analysis and workflow state only.
dataDesign.transactionalStore: Azure SQL Database with Microsoft Entra-only authentication, private endpoint, publicNetworkAccess Disabled, TDE, auditing and automated backups.
dataDesign.objectStores: Separate private Blob Storage accounts/containers for quarantine, admitted evidence, temporary work, audit export and Internal Audit verdicts, with controlled primary-to-approved-recovery replication under the owning boundary.
dataDesign.retrievalStore: Azure AI Search holds rebuildable derived chunks and vectors keyed to evidenceId; it is not an authoritative record.
dataDesign.classification: Production case, deal, financial, legal and portfolio data is highly confidential. Development and test contain synthetic data only.
dataDesign.partitioning: All transactional and derived entities carry caseId. Blob paths use environment/caseId/evidenceId/version. Search filters include caseId, classification, policyVersion and admissionStatus.
dataDesign.retention: No duration is invented. Every record carries retentionScheduleId, legalHoldId when applicable and dispositionStatus. Production lifecycle policies remain disabled or non-destructive until source/records owners approve schedules under VAL-004.
dataDesign.trainingBoundary: No Azure OpenAI fine-tuning or custom foundation-model training is deployed. Stratton prompts, completions and source documents are not placed in a training dataset.

submissionIdentity.submissionId: base64url without padding of SHA-256 over domain STRATTON-ASSURANCE-SUBMISSION-ID-v1 and RFC 8785 object {producerTenantId,producerObjectId,validationRunId}
submissionIdentity.replay: Same unique run plus same manifestHash returns existing submission/acceptance receipt/verdict. Same unique run plus different manifestHash returns 409 and security alert without mutation.
submissionIdentity.correction: Corrected attempt has new validationRunId and explicit supersedesSubmissionId; prior immutable records remain.

apis.result: 202 submissionId and status URI; not acceptance or verdict
exact submission verdict; optional manifestHash must match or 409

rules: Immutable Azure Blob version in approved account/container allow-list

pullAndCopy.reader: Internal Audit-owned read-only managed identity at exact source account/container scope
steps: Validate resource ID/container against source allow-list; construct SDK request without redirects
Use approved private DNS/path to fetch exact blobVersionId with ETag condition
Verify ETag, SHA-256, size, media type, malware, archive-bomb and active-content policy
Copy to Internal Audit WORM and persist source/version/copy hashes
Issue signed acceptance receipt only after durable copy and SQL/outbox commit
pullAndCopy.failure: Inaccessible/replaced/deleted/version/ETag/hash/size/type/redirect/public-path/scan/copy failure denies. Workload cannot write/delete assurance copy.

evaluationInputs.authority: Internal Audit approves values; workload may request a binding but cannot define authoritative policy/decision. Verdict binds values and copied object hashes.

sandbox.dynamicExecution: Requires separate Internal Audit authorisation for exact suite/artifact/release.
controls: no public egress; approved private dependencies only
destroy sandbox after result; retain evidence
sandbox.failure: Unavailable sandbox/policy, limit breach or isolation uncertainty produces INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL, never PASS.

verdictSchema.rule: Only Internal Audit creates; workload policy/decision non-authoritative; missing/non-final/invalid/inconclusive never PASS or human approval.

assuranceVerdictBoundary.failureRecovery: No alternate/local verdict. Internal Audit restores and validates immutable copies/outbox/registries/releases before resuming exact submission.

authority.AI Governance: approves exact provider adapter, prompt, model/deployment, embedding, safety, chunking, instruction/data separation, injection controls, retrieval schema/filter/revocation and limits
authority.Application Engineering: implements provider-neutral adapter without tools/autonomous action
authority.Data Owner: approves admitted evidence, licence/revocation and citation policy
authority.Workload: executes exact immutable binding and writes draft/rebuildable output only

configurationBinding.immutability: Snapshot per run; any changed/missing/expired approval requires a new binding and run.

inputManifest.admission: All entries ADMITTED, unrevoked, licence-valid and tenant/case matched at admission and again before use.

adapterRequestSchema.idempotency: Unique tenantId/caseId/idempotencyKey plus canonical request hash. Exact replay returns run; different body is 409 before provider call.

adapterResponseSchema.rule: Material claim without exact valid citation fails; citation locator/content/version is reverified at review.

vectorRecordSchema.key: base64url SHA-256 over domain STRATTON-VECTOR-KEY-v1 and RFC 8785 {tenantId,caseId,evidenceId,evidenceVersionId,chunkId,configurationBindingHash}; prevents cross-tenant/case collision
vectorRecordSchema.chunkTextHash: lowercase SHA-256 using domain STRATTON-CHUNK-TEXT-v1 over RFC 8785 {tenantId,caseId,evidenceVersionId,chunkId,chunkText}; raw text is not a key
vectorRecordSchema.validation: Actual vector length equals approved dimension; all provenance/hash/policy/schema values match binding and manifest; reject whole batch without truncate/pad/fallback.

searchContract.query: Server injects tenantId, caseId, permitted classification, ADMITTED and unexpired licence filters from authenticated/policy context. Caller filter text is never accepted or concatenated.
searchContract.alias: Versioned known-good index behind approved alias. Build/validate separately; atomically switch only after hostile/retrieval/citation/provenance validation.
searchContract.revocation: Evidence revocation, licence expiry or content/version/hash change invalidates affected chunks and runs, denies retrieval, and triggers rebuild from admitted evidence. Old index remains non-queryable after validated alias switch.

hostileContentControls: Treat evidence as data, never system/developer instruction
Instruction/data separation policy applied before chunking and inference
Prompt-injection classifier/control and approved evaluation corpus bound to configuration
No tool use, function calling, autonomous action, source write-back or external communication
analysisAndVectorizationBoundary.transactionRecovery: Admission/binding snapshot commits in SQL before workload outbox. Provider/index writes are replay-safe by deterministic keys. Failure leaves drafts/non-queryable index; rebuild versioned index and switch alias only after validation.

auditExportPushContract.authority: Workload owns source SQL transaction/outbox/signing sender. Internal Audit owns private queue, receiver, accepted continuity, WORM authority copy, receipt signer, quarantine/DLQ, retention and recovery. Receipt proves authenticated receipt/integrity only—not event truth, control effectiveness or compliance.
auditExportPushContract.transaction: Business mutation, unsigned canonical AuditEvent fields and AuditOutbox row commit in one workload SQL transaction; signer finalises event/message before send. No assurance database participates and no cross-database distributed transaction.

stream.allocation: SQL transaction lock allocates sequence and previousEventHash. Sender dispatches strictly in ascending sequence per stream and does not send N+1 until N has transport acceptance; material guard still requires signed authority receipt.
stream.replayConflict: Same position and same eventHash is replay. Same position and different eventHash is conflict/quarantine/alert even though eventId differs. Unknown schema, gap, malformed signature, conflict or poison never advances accepted continuity.

eventSchema.signature: WORKLOAD_AUDIT_EVENT purpose; token tenant/object must match trusted producer/signer mapping

messageSchema.messageBodyHash: canonicalCryptographicContract.hashes.messageBodyHash; computed last over final signed body excluding only messageBodyHash
messageSchema.size: Canonical UTF-8 body byte length must not exceed approved auditMessageMaxBytes or Service Bus entity limit; no compression/fragment fallback

auditExportPushContract.transport: Internal Audit-owned Service Bus Premium queue through approved private endpoint. Sender managed identity has Data Sender only at queue scope. Duplicate detection, TTL, dead-letter-on-expiry, maximum delivery and ordering are explicit approved inputs.
receiver: Validate private authenticated transport, schema and message size
Resolve producer registry/signer mapping and require token producer tenant/object match
Recompute eventHash then eventId; verify producer signature; recompute final messageBodyHash
Enforce stream position uniqueness and predecessor against last VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS authority event
Write event and receipt to WORM and commit assurance SQL/outbox before complete
Gap is GAP_HELD without continuity advancement; malformed/conflict/poison goes quarantine/DLQ without advancement

receiptSchema.meaning: Authenticated receipt/integrity/continuity disposition only; not truth or compliance attestation.

reconciliation.identity: Role-separated workload receipt-reconciler identity has receipt-read only and cannot update authority receipt/event.
reconciliation.verification: Resolve Internal Audit receipt trust, verify purpose/key/algorithm/validity/revocation, recompute receiptHash/signature, and match exact eventId/eventHash/messageBodyHash/tenantId/caseId/sequence before local status VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS.
reconciliation.guard: Material transition guard uses only a valid signed VERIFIED_CONTIGUOUS receipt for exact event/body/stream. Dispatcher/reconciler/business writer roles are separated; direct workload database update cannot fabricate success.

configurationRelations: auditDuplicateDetectionWindowSeconds covers the approved maximum duplicate-send interval
auditMessageMaxBytes is positive and no greater than approved entity capability
sender ordering policy requires one active dispatcher lease per tenantId/caseId stream
auditExportPushContract.retryFailure: Bounded exponential jittered retry from owner inputs. Exhaustion remains in outbox and alerts. DLQ/quarantine/immutable records are never skipped, purged or overwritten. Rollback stops sender/receiver and preserves outbox, DLQ, quarantine, WORM events/receipts and continuity state.
auditExportPushContract.recovery: Replay each stream in order, resolve gaps/conflicts under Internal Audit authority, verify producer and receipt signatures/trust and predecessor continuity, then authorise material-transition reopen.

common.timestamp: UTC RFC 3339 fixed millisecond precision YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.fffZ; offsets and local time rejected
common.strings: Unicode strings must be valid and represented exactly as RFC 8785; no pre-hash normalisation
common.signatureRule: Signature bytes, algorithm and key versions are supplied only by approved algorithm policy/trust records; no algorithm default. Signatures cover the named lowercase hash and purpose context defined by the approved algorithm policy.

arrayOrdering.assuranceResultObjects: ascending objectRole, storageAccountResourceId, containerName, blobName, blobVersionId using ordinal Unicode code-point order
arrayOrdering.inputManifestEntries: ascending tenantId, caseId, evidenceId, evidenceVersionId, citationLocator
arrayOrdering.otherArrays: Schema declares ordered or set semantics. Set-semantic arrays are ordinal-sorted and duplicate-free before hashing; undeclared ordering fails closed.

configurationBindingHash.requiredBinding: provider adapter, prompt, model, embedding, chunking, instruction/data separation, prompt-injection controls, safety, retrieval/filter/index, revocation, limits and approval evidence

inputManifestHash.requiredBinding: tenantId, caseId, evidence/version/content hashes, classification, admission, licence expiry, locator and chunking policy binding

manifestHash.requiredBinding: trusted producer, validation run, supersession, all exact immutable result-object versions, evaluation inputs and schema versions

eventHash.object: audit event before event ID/signature/message body hash
eventHash.requiredBinding: tenantId, caseId, sequence, predecessor, source transaction, actor/action/subject/outcome/correlation and schema

eventId.object: tenantId, caseId, sequence and resulting eventHash
eventId.encoding: base64url without padding of SHA-256 preimage digest; eventHash must already exist

messageBodyHash.object: final message body including eventId, eventHash and producer signature metadata/signature
messageBodyHash.requiredBinding: exact Service Bus body; headers repeat identifiers but body is authoritative for hash verification

receiptHash.requiredBinding: verified producer tenant/object, producer signature metadata, eventHash, final messageBodyHash, stream position, disposition and assurance signer purpose

verdictHash.requiredBinding: submission/manifest, copied object hashes, evaluation policy/registries/suite/evaluator release/schema/limits, decision and reasons

canonicalCryptographicContract.failClosed: Unknown schema/domain, duplicate set entry, invalid timestamp/Unicode, non-canonical form, uppercase/non-64-hex referenced SHA-256, ordering mismatch or hash mismatch denies processing.

verification: Resolve exact purpose-specific algorithm policy and trust registry version/hash
Validate key purpose, producer/signer mapping, tenant/object identity, algorithm, key ID/version, validity interval, rotation state and revocation/compromise status
Require Entra token tenant/object identity to equal trusted producer registry identity and signer mapping
Verify signature over approved purpose context and named hash
Deny missing, expired, not-yet-valid, revoked, compromised, mismatched or unavailable policy/registry/key/identity
signatureAndProducerTrust.separation: Submission, audit event, receipt and verdict purposes use separately authorised keys and mappings. A key authorised for one purpose is invalid for another. No algorithm value is selected by this proposal.
